title: Finishing the twin - GLLVM.jl + gllvmTMB
mission: Finish the R-Julia twin: GLLVM.jl as the Julia engine and gllvmTMB as the R user surface. A capability is done only when engine support, R bridge support, point estimates, objective/logLik, CI or CI-status, docs/articles, visual evidence, tests, issue ledger, and Rose audit agree.
current_work: Phase 4/5 gap fill is active: gllvmTMB now matches the current minimal no-X GLLVM.bridge_fit contract (live bridge test 49/0), #96 and #92 are locally fixed in the board worktree, and #91 is reproduced + locally fixed on GLLVM.jl-integration branch codex/high-rate-poisson-safeguard with focused tests green. X, mixed families, missingness bridge, R/TMB statistical parity, Gamma default benchmarking, and full-suite gates remain queued.

activity.html: Gauss/Karpinski #96 local fix green. Shared Laplace mode finder now backtracks large uphill Fisher steps, keeps full near-mode steps, and zero-restarts after non-finite solves; new safeguard test 5/5 and full Pkg.test() passed.

Hopper/Rose gllvmTMB gate shrink green. R now rejects X, mixed families, NB1/lognormal, missing latent blocks, and unsupported CI payloads before pretending the Julia bridge can fit them; live julia-bridge test passed 49/0.
Hopper bridge slice green. bridge_fit is exported on this branch for no-X one-part families; focused test, core suite, and full Pkg.test() passed.
Fisher/Noether #92 fix green. Packed phylo signal now matches public phylo_signal; transformed-Wald test 102/102 and full Pkg.test() passed.
Rose public-doc cleanup. Non-Gaussian CI and R-bridge status pages now say partial instead of stale planned/deferred wording; Documenter build passed.
Mission-control implementation started. Board now reads status.json, sweep.json, and version.txt instead of hard-coded completion prose.
Hopper bridge audit. Initial blocker was real: the branch lacked GLLVM.bridge_fit. First narrow no-X route is now implemented; X, mixed families, missingness, and gllvmTMB roundtrip remain open.
Rose audit. No publish/tag signoff: dashboard and public docs must not imply main, registry, CRAN, or bridge completion.
Grace/Shannon truth snapshot. GLLVM #95 is green but draft; #94 is divergent/non-mergeable; gllvmTMB f046d0f is local-only with no remote CI.
#91 reproduced + locally fixed on integration. High-rate Poisson beta6 now stays on empirical scale; focused tests pass, full-suite gate pending.

Imported cross-team lessons. DRM contributes bridge-drift/profile-CI discipline; HSquared contributes validation-status and AI-REML boundary discipline.
